readThrough.checks: Read every root and lesson field: situation/title/caption spoiler check, all six turns for natural German and token bounds (them 14–18, you1 16–21, you2 17–20, you3 14–17, focus 8–12), you2 answers them2 specifically and you3 performs the closing move after a real steer in all ten; moves pairwise distinct and whitelisted, pattern.moveType in-episode; registers Sie/du consistent with no cross-register pronouns in you turns; neutral learner text everywhere; carriers staged per corrected P1 table (L1 einerseits/andererseits, je…desto, zugegeben, insgesamt; L2 ich tendiere zu, zwar…aber, unterm Strich; L3 da, Komparativ+als, deshalb empfehle ich; L4 aus meiner Sicht, das stimmt aber; L5 im Vergleich zu, dennoch; L6 zumal, alles in allem; L7 während; L8 das ändert nichts daran dass; nothing from P2 or later lessons in learner turns); every build/cloze/synthesis/recall reconstruction verified character by character; every choice set and fallback set tested in full visible context (one option expresses the shown intent; other grammatical options contradict it); every term found verbatim folded in dialogue or pattern example; speak tokens whole tokens with ≥2 inside focus; all ten trophies equal the ledger allocation, surfaces whole tokens of the declared turn, examples contain the surface; no digits/URLs/emoji in voiced text; review blocks all pending/false/unreviewed.
readThrough.remainingConcerns: Form blanks on everyday verbs (brauche, übe, bezahle, gebe, bleibe, prüfen) are reconstruction checks, not the B2 load; licensed because the move blank carries the carrier in every lesson, but L2's copula blank was replaced. Situation texts address the learner with Du in all ten lessons (exemplar used Sie); licensed as instructional address, not interlocutor register, and must stay outside the Sie/du detector. L1 them3 'Welche Grenze setzen Sie Ihrer Entscheidung?' and L8 'mit meiner Betreuung vereinbar' are acceptable but slightly formal; no edit. abwägen appears as a plain verb in L9 before the L10 trophy Abwägung; not a trophy collision, kept as pre-exposure.

arbitration.reason: Equally natural order; regrouping to ['Da','konzentriertes Arbeiten zu Hause','leichter','fällt','als im Großraumbüro,'] keeps five chunks, no voiced text change; leichter cannot move because the comma chunk is final and V-final binds fällt.

arbitration.finding: P1-IR-03 L6 build order (object before subject)
arbitration.reason: 'zumal meine Ausgaben die App erfasst' is grammatical but contrastively marked; closing it is cheap. The reviewer's merge creates an unnatural subject+object chip; ['zumal die App','meine Ausgaben','erfasst','und keine zusätzlichen Gebühren','verlangt.'] fixes the subject after the connector, keeps five meaningful chunks and all speak tokens inside the focus.
Both adverb positions are native and identical in meaning; grouping 'spontan auf andere Menschen' (four tokens) removes the ambiguity with five chunks left.

arbitration.finding: P1-IR-05 L9 build order (predicate nominative fronting) and brächte…mit sich rewrite
arbitration.reason: The reversal is marked but grammatical, so the chip set must bind wäre to its subject. The brächte rewrite is rejected: Konjunktiv II brächte is stilted in speech and would not close the order anyway. Fix without touching voiced text: bind 'wäre die Entfernung', move 'im Alltag.' into the chips (frameSuffix empty, focus 12 tokens, period fixes it last), and replace the now-useless distractor 'die Nähe' with 'wäre die Nähe'. 'eine spürbare Einschränkung zu meinem vertrauten Umfeld' is not a plausible German reading (Einschränkung takes no zu-complement), so it is not an ambiguity.

arbitration.finding: P1-IR-06 L6 synthesis Lockangebot also coherent
arbitration.reason: The visible base says 'as an additional option'; Lockangebot (loss leader) does not express that intent and shifts the recommendation into marketing. Grammatical-but-wrong-in-context options are legitimate choices; moving the blank to empfehle would replace a meaning test with an A2 form test.

arbitration.finding: P1-AR-01 and author flag: L8 carrier 'das ändert nichts daran, dass' has five tokens, Dennoch is blanked
arbitration.reason: B2-10 requires the move blank to be a carrier staged at or before the lesson, not the newly staged one. Rule for the German P1 spec: a carrier longer than the four-token frame cap is introduced through a pattern example, a highlight and a term; the move blank then uses an already-staged carrier of the same move. L8 implements exactly that; no contract change, record this sentence in the path spec notes.

arbitration.finding: P1-AR-02 and author flag: B2-22 earlier-path recycling has no earlier B2 path for P1
arbitration.reason: For pathNumber 1 the 'earlier path carrier list' is defined as the German B1 carrier/trophy rows plus this path's earlier lessons (consistent with the b2BeforeB1 resolution that recycling checks use ledger rows). P1 L6–L10 satisfy it (L6 zugegeben, L7 zwar/unterm Strich, L8 aus meiner Sicht/dennoch/insgesamt, L9 einerseits…andererseits/das stimmt aber/unterm Strich, L10 da/dennoch/alles in allem, plus B1 weil/denn/wenn/trotzdem/jedoch). If the validator still emits B2-22 for P1, Codex acknowledges it with this reason; no fabricated earlier path.

arbitration.finding: P1-AR-03 governing standard for choices, distractors and build order
arbitration.reason: Standard: exactly one option may express the intent shown in the visible base; other options may be grammatical if they contradict or distort that meaning; an option that plausibly expresses the same intent makes the item ambiguous and must be repaired. Build: any grammatical, meaning-preserving and unmarked permutation must be excluded by chunk grouping, attached punctuation or the frame; marked permutations (contrastive fronting) are closed when a 5–8-chunk regrouping exists. Per-lesson application above; no blanket grammar-only rewrite.

arbitration.finding: Author/exemplar divergence: situation texts use Du (exemplar Sie)
arbitration.reason: Situation is unvoiced instructional address to the learner, consistent across all ten lessons and matching the app's learner-facing tone; the Sie/du detector applies to dialogue turns only. Judge by corrected P1 staging, not by the exemplar's address.

arbitration.finding: Fable: L2 cloze blank 'sind' is copula filler
arbitration.reason: A copula form is an A1 reconstruction check (criterion 12); 'ebenfalls' is the hinge of the concession (traffic jams are unpredictable too). Lexical blank with choices ebenfalls/keineswegs/selten/angeblich: only ebenfalls expresses the shown 'too'; 'auch' accepted for typed input. arbitration.reason: Normalization keeps internal commas; add 'Das stimmt aber' as accepted variant in L4 and L9 so a comma-less typed answer passes; choices unaffected.

edits.newValue: Einerseits gewinne ich durch den Umzug Zeit, andererseits
edits.reason: Move the connector into the fixed frame so the focus drops to 12 lexical tokens (wäre die Entfernung zu meinem vertrauten Umfeld eine spürbare Einschränkung im Alltag = 12); the einerseits/andererseits pair is already the pattern highlight and stays visible as frame, while Entfernung and Einschränkung keep ≥2 speakRequired tokens in the focus.

Keeps 5 chunks (each 1–4 tokens) after removing the connector by splitting the dative phrase into preposition+determiner and adjective+noun. 'wäre die Entfernung' binds the subject directly to the verb, so the predicative nominal 'eine spürbare Einschränkung' can no longer be fronted before the subject (the accepted predicate-fronting alternate is closed); 'im Alltag.' carries the full stop and is forced last; the only other reordering ('…Einschränkung zu meinem vertrauten Umfeld im Alltag') misattaches the PP and is not native. prefix+chunks.join(' ')+suffix equals the dialogue[1] turn exactly; distractors 'wäre die Nähe' and 'eine deutliche Entlastung' remain distinct from all chips and yield semantically wrong sentences.
